apiKeys.intro: Let Claude, Cursor and other AI agents clip videos for you through the <brand>SupoClip MCP server</brand>, or call the REST API from your own code. Treat keys like passwords; they grant full access to your account.

creator.intro: Making videos about SupoClip? Get your own code: your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months, and you get SupoClip Pro for free.

deleteAccount.title: Danger zone
deleteAccount.label: Delete account
deleteAccount.hint: Permanently delete your account, generations, clips and API keys.
deleteAccount.dialogBody: This permanently deletes your account, all generations and clips, and revokes your API keys. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.appStore: Your subscription is managed through the App Store. Deleting your account doesn't cancel it, so cancel it in your App Store subscriptions to stop being charged.

cancel.placeholder: What made you decide to cancel?
cancel.restarted: Your subscription will renew as normal.
